function.name: NotificationHook
function.description: This function checks if the token is null and returns a status based on the check.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a token that is checked within the function.

function.return_type: Status, represents the result of the function, returns 'InvalidParameter' if token is null, otherwise returns 'Ok'.

function.name: NotificationUnhook
function.description: This function is used to unhook a notification using a token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: This parameter is used to identify the notification to be unhooked.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: DllMain
function.description: This function is an entry point to a DLL. It is called by the system when processes and threads are initialized and terminated, or upon using LoadLibrary and FreeLibrary. It handles the DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH and DLL_PROCESS_DETACH cases to initialize and clean up resources respectively.

parameters.name: hinst
parameters.description: A handle to the DLL module. The value is the base address of the DLL.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason code that indicates why the DLL entry-point function is being called.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: If the DLL_PROCESS_DETACH is due to a process termination, the reserved parameter will be non-null. If the DLL_PROCESS_DETACH is due to a call to FreeLibrary, the reserved parameter will be NULL.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not. The function always returns TRUE.

function.name: GdiplusStartup
function.description: This function initializes the Microsoft GDI+ version 1.0 library and provides a startup token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG_PTR variable that receives a token.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Pointer to a GdiplusStartupInput structure that specifies how the GDI+ version 1.0 library should be initialized.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Pointer to a GdiplusStartupOutput structure. If the SuppressBackgroundThread member of the input parameter is TRUE, the GDI+ version 1.0 library will provide notification hooks in this structure.

function.return_type: Status, represents the status of the function execution. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if the token or input is null, 'UnsupportedGdiplusVersion' if the GdiplusVersion is not 1 or 2, and 'Ok' if the function executes successfully.

function.name: GdiplusNotificationHook
function.description: This function is used to hook notifications in GDI+.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a token that is used for the notification hook.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation.

function.name: GdiplusNotificationUnhook
function.description: This function unregisters a previously registered notification hook.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: This is a token that represents the notification hook to be unregistered.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: GdiplusShutdown_wrapper
function.description: This function is a wrapper for GdiplusShutdown with a slightly different prototype. It currently does not track objects and is expected to return a value of 0.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: This parameter is not currently used in the function.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the function execution, currently always returns 0

function.name: GdipAlloc
function.description: This function allocates memory of a given size.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the memory to be allocated.

function.return_type: void pointer, represents the starting address of the allocated memory.

function.name: GdipFree
function.description: This function is used to free the memory that has been previously allocated by malloc, calloc, etc.

parameters.name: ptr
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the memory block that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, it does not return any value.

function.name: add_arc_part
function.description: This function calculates the points on an arc of an ellipse and writes them into an array. It also expands the points back from the unit circle to the ellipse.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Pointer to an array where the calculated points are stored

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: y1
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: Width of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: y2
parameters.description: Height of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Starting angle of the arc, in radians

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Ending angle of the arc, in radians

parameters.name: write_first
parameters.description: If TRUE, the function writes the starting point of the arc into the array. If FALSE, it starts from the second point.

function.return_type: void

function.name: unstretch_angle
function.description: This function unstretches an angle based on the given x and y diameters. It calculates the stretched angle and adjusts it based on the number of revolutions off from the original angle.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The original angle to be unstretched.

parameters.name: dia_x
parameters.description: The x diameter used for unstretching the angle.

parameters.name: dia_y
parameters.description: The y diameter used for unstretching the angle.

function.return_type: REAL, representing the unstretched angle.

function.name: arc2polybezier
function.description: This function converts an arc defined by its bounding rectangle, start angle and sweep angle into a series of cubic bezier curves.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of GpPointF structures that receives the bezier points.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: start_angle
parameters.description: The start angle of the arc, measured in degrees clockwise from the x-axis.

parameters.name: sweep_angle
parameters.description: The sweep angle of the arc, measured in degrees clockwise from the start_angle.

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of points added to the points array. If no points are added, the function returns 0.

function.name: ARGB2COLORREF
function.description: This function converts ARGB color format to COLORREF format. It doesn't handle alpha channel.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This parameter is the ARGB color that needs to be converted to COLORREF format.

function.return_type: COLORREF, which represents the converted color from ARGB to COLORREF format.

function.name: ARGB2BMP
function.description: This function converts an ARGB color to a bitmap (BMP).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This parameter represents the ARGB color that will be converted to a bitmap.

function.return_type: HBITMAP, which represents the bitmap created from the ARGB color.

function.name: gdiplus_atan2
function.description: This function calculates the arctangent of the two variables dy and dx. It handles the case where dx is zero separately to avoid division by zero.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of a point

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of a point

function.return_type: REAL, representing the arctangent of the two input parameters

function.name: hresult_to_status
function.description: This function converts a HRESULT into a GpStatus by using a switch case statement.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: This parameter is used to represent the HRESULT that needs to be converted into a GpStatus.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation.

function.name: units_to_pixels
function.description: This function converts units to pixels based on the unit type and dpi provided. It also considers whether the display is a printer display or not.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: The amount of units to be converted to pixels.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: The type of unit to be converted.

parameters.name: dpi
parameters.description: The dots per inch, used in the conversion calculation.

parameters.name: printer_display
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the display is a printer display or not.

function.return_type: REAL, representing the converted units in pixels.

function.name: pixels_to_units
function.description: This function converts pixels to different units based on the unit type provided.

parameters.name: pixels
parameters.description: The number of pixels to be converted.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: The unit type to which the pixels will be converted.

parameters.name: dpi
parameters.description: The dots per inch value for the conversion.

parameters.name: printer_display
parameters.description: A boolean value that determines if the display is a printer display.

function.return_type: REAL, represents the converted value in the specified unit.

function.name: units_scale
function.description: This function converts units to pixels and then back to units, effectively scaling the units.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The original unit to be converted to pixels.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The unit to which pixels will be converted back.

parameters.name: dpi
parameters.description: The resolution in dots per inch used for conversion.

parameters.name: printer_display
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the conversion is for a printer display.

function.return_type: REAL, representing the scaled units.

function.name: calc_curve_bezier
function.description: This function calculates the control points for a Bezier curve based on the input points and tension.

parameters.name: pts
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of points used for calculating the Bezier curve

parameters.name: tension
parameters.description: The tension of the curve

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: Pointer to the x-coordinate of the first control point

parameters.name: y1
parameters.description: Pointer to the y-coordinate of the first control point

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: Pointer to the x-coordinate of the second control point

parameters.name: y2
parameters.description: Pointer to the y-coordinate of the second control point

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the values pointed to by the x1, y1, x2, y2 pointers

function.name: calc_curve_bezier_endp
function.description: This function calculates the end point of a bezier curve based on the given parameters.

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: x-coordinate of the end point

parameters.name: yend
parameters.description: y-coordinate of the end point

parameters.name: xadj
parameters.description: x-coordinate of the adjacent point

parameters.name: yadj
parameters.description: y-coordinate of the adjacent point

parameters.name: tension
parameters.description: tension of the curve

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: pointer to store the calculated x-coordinate of the end point

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: pointer to store the calculated y-coordinate of the end point

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the values pointed by 'x' and 'y'

function.name: lengthen_path
function.description: This function lengthens the path by allocating or reallocating memory. If the initial allocation is zero, it allocates memory of double the length. If the path data length is less than the length, it reallocates memory by doubling the size of arrays until it is not less than the length.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the path that needs to be lengthened.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: This is the length that the path needs to be extended to.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the memory allocation or reallocation is successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: convert_32bppARGB_to_32bppPARGB
function.description: This function converts a 32-bit ARGB image to a 32-bit PARGB image.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the image in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the image in pixels.

parameters.name: dst_bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination buffer where the converted image will be stored.

parameters.name: dst_stride
parameters.description: The stride (in bytes) of the destination buffer.

parameters.name: src_bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the source buffer containing the original image.

parameters.name: src_stride
parameters.description: The stride (in bytes) of the source buffer.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the destination buffer directly.

function.name: delete_element
function.description: This function deletes an element based on its type. If the type is RegionDataPath, it deletes the path. If the type is not recognized, it deletes the left and right elements of the combine type and frees the memory.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: This is the element to be deleted. It is a pointer to a region_element structure.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything

function.name: debugstr_rectf
function.description: This function returns a formatted string representing the coordinates and dimensions of a rectangle.

parameters.name: rc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle structure that needs to be formatted into a string.

function.return_type: char: This represents the formatted string of the rectangle's coordinates and dimensions.

function.name: debugstr_pointf
function.description: This function returns a formatted string representing the coordinates of a PointF object. If the PointF object is null, it returns the string '(null)'.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Pointer to a PointF object whose coordinates are to be formatted into a string.

function.return_type: char: A string representing the coordinates of the PointF object in the format '(x,y)', or '(null)' if the PointF object is null.

function.name: debugstr_matrix
function.description: This function returns a formatted string that represents the values of a given matrix. If the matrix is null, it returns the string '(null)'.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is the matrix whose values are to be formatted into a string.

function.return_type: char: Returns a string that represents the values of the matrix. If the matrix is null, it returns the string '(null)'.
